description: A handwritten copy of the retained-column tuple Runner v0.27.0 compiles and installs (#269). sourceLine is the declaration copied verbatim from the cited file; json is the JSON encoding/json writes for that value through Runner's ConversionSpec type, whose members are version, revision, schemaSha256 and corpusSha256 in that order. Both languages hold DialectRetainedColumnDraft().Spec / DIALECT_RETAINED_COLUMN_DRAFT.spec to json byte for byte, and the Go test also reads the four values out of sourceLine. Its schema and corpus digests are the SHA-256 of schema/retained-column/1/contract.schema.json and conformance/retained-column/1/cases.json in the Spec v0.3.0 release archive, whose release-identity.json names source commit 27cb29bf13e4a2d58d69fe19c7ebfeb762b014fc.
sourceLine: var installedConversionSpec = ConversionSpec{Version: "0.3.0", Revision: "27cb29bf13e4a2d58d69fe19c7ebfeb762b014fc", SchemaSHA256: "sha256:0cb49f238c78391cb163a65474cc9af962df2bb1024a55c5310c2b784b2f0557", CorpusSHA256: "sha256:17b16ff7a9b74fe4cc81eb6f6129a6aabdd9834621d9e756aa2d4c1a3f245863"}
